SECTION 06 // BRIEFING

■ FAQ

▸ What is MECHA WAR?

7,777 combat mechas on BNB Chain. Six classes — Scout, Vanguard, Titan, Warlord, Prime and the mythic Omega. Each mint is a random draw from the six classes.

▸ How much does a mint cost?

Your first mint per wallet is FREE while 777 free mints last. After the free pool runs out, every mint costs 0.0003 BNB. You always pay BNB gas on top.

▸ How many can I mint?

Max 10 mechas per wallet and max 10 per transaction.

▸ How does the marketplace work?

List your mecha on this site — the NFT is held by the market contract (escrow) while listed. Buyers pay in BNB, the seller receives 95% and a 5% fee goes to the collection owner. You can cancel your listing any time to get your mecha back.

▸ Is there a token?

Yes. Every MechaWar NFT claims 10,000 $MECH — once per NFT. The claim fee is 0.0004 BNB per NFT, and $MECH is minted straight to your wallet on claim. Cap: 100,000,000 $MECH. No presale, no staking. Claim your $MECH here →
